# Aritro Shome (sortira)

> Personal website of Aritro Shome (a.k.a. sortira), a student research engineer working on interpretability and alignment. Currently a research intern at AI4Bharat (visual reasoning, multimodal & multilingual interpretability); previously an AI engineer intern at Sarvam AI. Interests: reasoning models, RL, synthetic data, and local/edge AI.

The site is a single-page portfolio hosted at https://sortira.github.io/, plus an "other" page for secondary details. Clean markdown versions of each page are linked below.

## Main

- [Home](https://sortira.github.io/index.html.md): Bio, current and past experience (AI4Bharat, Sarvam AI), education, and solo research projects (forgeformer; seven deadly sins of gemma).
- [Other](https://sortira.github.io/other.html.md): Achievements and hackathon wins, smaller builds, certifications, skills, and extracurricular awards.

## Writing

- [silicognition](https://silicognition.is-a.dev/): Technical blog on solo research projects and encounters with AI.

## Optional

- [forgeformer — writeup](https://silicognition.is-a.dev/post2.html): Hand-designed 2-layer transformer that adds two-digit numbers with no gradient descent; interpretable weights built from the ground up.
- [forgeformer — demo](https://aritro.is-a.dev/forgeformer): Interactive demo.
- [seven deadly sins of gemma](https://silicognition.is-a.dev/post3.html): Steering vectors per "sin" in gemma-2-2b, verified via steering examples and activation patching.
